note: Hand-review calls on signoff trajectories, applied by build.py. split: the trajectory is cut before each listed revision, and each part is judged separately against the two-edit rule. partition: like split, for runs whose edits interleave; each of 'groups' ({run, revs}) becomes a part, numbered by its first edit, and 'unplaced' edits go to no trajectory (as in exclude, with 'by'). keep: reviewed and left whole; its trajectory-level flags stay in trajectories.jsonl but leave review_queue.tsv. not_alias: the name and each name in 'of' are different agents (blocks alias merges and alias candidates between them). reassign: the listed revisions are by 'to'; they move there, keeping the carried signoff in reassigned_from. exclude: the listed revisions were not made by the name's agent; they go to no trajectory, and 'by' maps each to its likely author. merge: the name and 'into' are one agent under two signoffs; all the name's edits move to 'into', keeping their own signoff in signed_as. attribute: the listed unsigned revisions were written by 'name' (a hand attribution from page, clock or claims); they join the name's edits, and a name may have several attribute reviews beside one other review. Post-verification build: the author's three 2026-09-27 hand calls made before any LLM reviewer, plus the OAI7C97 not_alias, which rests on a task-clock chain the author checked; no other later call is included.
